query: WITH requested_divisions(name, sort_order) AS (VALUES ('Division 1', 1), ('Division 2', 2), ('Division 3', 3), ('Division 4', 4), ('Division 5', 5), ('Division 6', 6)), upserted_divisions AS (INSERT INTO public.b36_divisions (name, sort_order, identity) SELECT name, sort_order, 'Temporary placeholder division' FROM requested_divisions ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, identity = EXCLUDED.identity RETURNING id, name, sort_order), requested_teams(team_number, team_name, email, division_sort_order) AS (SELECT number, 'Team ' || number, 'team' || number || '@placeholder.36football.com', ((number - 1) / 6) + 1 FROM generate_series(1, 36) AS number), upserted_owners AS (INSERT INTO public.b36_owners (display_name, team_name, email, division_id, is_commissioner, draft_order, program_identity, manus_open_id) SELECT requested.team_name, requested.team_name, requested.email, division.id, false, requested.team_number, 'Temporary placeholder program', NULL FROM requested_teams AS requested JOIN upserted_divisions AS division ON division.sort_order = requested.division_sort_order ON CONFLICT (team_name) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, email = EXCLUDED.email, division_id = EXCLUDED.division_id, is_commissioner = false, draft_order = EXCLUDED.draft_order, program_identity = EXCLUDED.program_identity, manus_open_id = NULL, updated_at = now() RETURNING id, team_name), inserted_slots AS (INSERT INTO public.b36_draft_slots (owner_id, position, draft_position, school_name, selected_at, selected_by_open_id) SELECT owner.id, position.position::public.b36_position, requested.team_number, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM upserted_owners AS owner JOIN requested_teams AS requested ON requested.team_name = owner.team_name CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('QB'), ('RB'), ('WR'), ('TE'), ('K_ST'), ('DEF')) AS position(position) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.b36_draft_slots AS slot WHERE slot.owner_id = owner.id AND slot.position = position.position::public.b36_position) RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted_divisions) AS processed_divisions, (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted_owners) AS processed_owners, (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted_slots) AS inserted_slots LIMIT 1;
